spec_match.rationale: Builds and sends the explainer's exact split/splitposition/splitsize window features through a real window.open(), with the explainer's detection ('windowFeatures' in HTMLAnchorElement.prototype plus a reflection round-trip).

interactive.rationale: Checkboxes, select and range build a live call preview. Open and close buttons act on a real handle, and the opened view reports back.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card's basic-usage description.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the guard, the popup fallback, noopener and close(). Whether a split happened cannot be read (by design); the opener-resize signal is labelled as inference.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: The IDL/reflection assertions fail honestly today. The split placement contract is manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: popup=0,split opened a tab with the opener kept; bare split opened a POPUP (toolbar.visible=false); noopener returned null and the report came via BroadcastChannel; close() set closed=true; no console errors; 0px overflow. the API is absent in Chromium 153 even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features / --enable-blink-features=WindowOpenSplitTab, so only the legacy branch was observed, and headless has no split-view UI.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the supported/unsupported probe branch and that the view reported back.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled controls, inline output for the range, live verdicts, visible focus, 44px targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes. On mobile the browser is expected to decline splits, and the page says the fallback is a tab.

openQuestions.title: Verify the real split path on a flagged desktop Canary
openQuestions.detail: Launch Canary with --enable-features=WindowOpenSplitTab on a wide window, then record whether a split appears, the opener resize signal, and close() collapsing the split.

guidanceConsulted.query: window.open popup features link opener noopener
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Be deliberate about opener relationships; use noopener/COOP when the opened page should not control the opener.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: noopener and rel=opener are explicit, visible toggles, and the copy explains that a split keeps the opener by default.

guidanceConsulted.query: window.open popup features link opener noopener
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Validate postMessage by exact origin (and source) before acting on cross-window messages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every message handler checks event.origin === location.origin, and the editor/preview also pin event.source to the handle/opener. The Origin API was not used (same-origin string equality is sufficient here).

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls radio group fieldset legend accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios/checkboxes in fieldset+legend and label every control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Option groups use fieldset/legend or wrapping labels; range inputs have associated label+output.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: Real window.open() playground with honest observation. The supporting path awaits a browser that ships the flag.
